mapper.sql: SELECT r.review_id, r.admin_dong_id, r.user_id, r.overall_rating, r.content, r.is_anonymous, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, ad.name AS admin_dong_name, g.name AS gu_name FROM reviews r INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id INNER JOIN admin_dongs ad ON ad.admin_dong_id = r.admin_dong_id INNER JOIN gus g ON g.gu_code = ad.gu_code
mapper.select:
r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.review_id DESC

SELECT rs.review_id, rs.review_category_id, rc.code AS category_code, rs.score FROM review_scores rs INNER JOIN review_categories rc ON rc.review_category_id = rs.review_category_id WHERE rs.review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY rs.review_category_id
SELECT role FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews ( admin_dong_id, user_id, overall_rating, content, is_anonymous, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{adminDongId}, #{userId}, #{overallRating}, #{content}, #{anonymous}, 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO review_scores ( review_id, review_category_id, score ) SELECT #{reviewId}, rc.review_category_id, #{score} FROM review_categories rc WHERE rc.code = #{categoryCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET overall_rating = #{overallRating}, content = #{content}, is_anonymous = #{anonymous}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE reviews SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_admin_actions ( review_id, action_type, reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{actionType}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
